subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Kumusta RECIPIENT_NAME,
Binabalikan ko ang naunang mensahe ko tungkol sa pagpapalago ng funded account para sa {Brand}. Isang punto ang ulit kong idiriin: nag-o-optimize kami patungo sa unang funded account, validated sa pamamagitan ng S2S postback mula sa MMP papunta sa first-funded event matapos pumasa sa KYC at anti-fraud check, kaya validated na deposito ang binabayaran ninyo. Sa antas ng MobUpps, umaabot kami ng 2,400 funded account bawat araw (illustrative). Kung makakatulong, ipapadala ko ang cohort view ayon sa channel. Mag-uusap kaya tayo nang maikli?
angle: warm bump, restate funded-account proof (S2S-validated first deposit)
illustrative_flags: 2,400 funded account bawat araw (2,400 funded accounts a day) - MobUpps-specific daily funded-account volume; illustrative, not an established result
register_notes: Stage 1 tl fintech_banking_and_payments CPS: references prior in first 2 sentences; restates single proof (funded account optimized + S2S MMP postback + KYC/anti-fraud, validated deposit); one illustrative MobUpps figure (2,400 funded/day, flagged); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; native Tagalog business register with neutral 'Kumusta' and preserved RECIPIENT_NAME slot; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' comma-negation.
